records.subject: Proton dissolution reaction
records.conditions: Below 1173 K in 1 mol% InO1.5-doped CaZrO3; defect chemical and irreversible thermochemical analyses
records.quote: Simultaneous measurements of total conductivity and thermoelectric power have been made on 1 mol% InO1.5-doped CaZrO3 (CaZr0.99In0.01O0.995) in order to evaluate defect chemical parameters and both electronic and ionic transport properties.
context_quotes: The concentrations of holes, protons, and oxygen vacancies and their mobility, in addition to the heat of transport of oxide ions and protons, have been estimated using defect chemical and irreversible thermochemical analyses.

The present results show that the dissolution reaction of protons saturates below 1173 K and the concentration of holes decreases by the dissolution of protons, indicating the presence of direct substitution of protons with holes.
